data.title: After Spending a Day as a Substitute Teacher, Frank Russo Unveils Veterans School Safety Plan
data.description: A candidate running for Governor in Florida, who is not affiliated with any political party, has suggested employing qualified veterans to enhance the protection of students in Florida schools. This proposal aims to provide teachers with increased peace of mind. The idea was put forward in New Smyrna Beach, Florida on September 14, 2026. The candidate envisions utilizing veterans' expertise to safeguard students, thereby contributing to a safer learning environment.

data.title: Transformer Engine from NVIDIA speeds up Dropless MoE training in JAX, delivering a 10x boost and 97% scaling efficiency.
data.description: NVIDIA has introduced the Transformer Engine that boosts Dropless Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) training in JAX, resulting in an impressive 10x increase in performance and achieving a remarkable 97% scaling efficiency for this process. This development marks a significant advancement in accelerating the training of MoE models, showcasing the potential for improved efficiency and effectiveness in computational tasks.

data.title: New: Anthropic's Claude for Financial Advisors integrates with Schwab, BlackRock, and Addepar, enhancing efficiency and client service.
data.description: Anthropic has introduced Claude, designed specifically for Financial Advisors, with integration capabilities with prominent platforms such as Schwab, BlackRock, and Addepar. Claude aims to streamline processes, allowing advisors to save time and enhance client service quality. The integration with these major tools signifies a significant step towards efficient and effective financial advisory services.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops New Meat Marinating Machine (CTK-2235)

data.title: HelloNation Article Featuring Roofing Expert Cody Slagle Explains the Post-Storm Roof Checklist Texoma Homeowners Should Follow
data.description: Following a severe storm in North Texas, homeowners in DENISON are advised to inspect their roof thoroughly to ensure its integrity. This involves checking shingles, gutters, flashing, and attic spaces for any signs of damage. The aftermath of a strong Texoma storm can leave roofs vulnerable, so it is crucial for homeowners to proactively assess the condition of their roofs. This article by HelloNation provides important guidelines for homeowners on how to conduct post-storm roof inspections. Taking these measures can help prevent further damage and ensure the safety of the property.

data.title: InventHelp Inventor Develops Device to Assist in Hanging Sheet Rock/Drywall (CTK-1999)
data.description: In Pittsburgh on September 14, 2026, an inventor from New Orleans, LA shared his creation, the HANDY MAN, aimed at simplifying the task of hanging sheet rock or drywall independently. The inventor, also a painter, recognized the need for a more efficient method and designed a solution that eliminates the necessity of seeking assistance. This invention could potentially revolutionize the construction industry and aid individuals working solo on such projects.

data.title: Lavender Appoints Two Clinical Leaders to Support Quality and Operations at Scale
data.description: The national telepsychiatry practice has recently named Kara Birch, who holds a Doctorate in Nursing Practice and certifications in Psychiatric Mental Health and Family Nurse Practice, as well as Anna Lau, with a Master of Science in Nursing and certifications in Psychiatric Mental Health and Women's Health Nurse Practice, to enhance their clinical excellence and nursing operations. The announcement was made in New York on September 14, 2026. This move comes as telepsychiatry continues to grow in providing broader access to mental health care services.
